verdict.rationale: The docs reference a native payroll payment flow (Pay > Make a Payment > Domestic) and advise checking data in Analytics > Custom Payroll Report and employee profiles "before running payroll." That shows Justworks itself runs payroll, but nothing describes the end-to-end run steps. Missing for 10: documented review of hours and earnings within the run, a pre-submit preview of totals, an explicit submit/approve step in a single flow, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
